title: Master-Disciple Truth
next_chapter_hook: The moment the remnant soul scattered into countless specks of light, Chen Ji felt a warm force surge into his meridians—this was Master Mo's final gift from a thousand years of cultivation, and also the heaviest burden of guardianship he would bear.

text.content: The bloody stench on the execution platform had yet to dissipate, yet Han Lie's wild laughter before death coiled around Chen Ji's heart like a lingering illness. He sat alone in the cottage at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the candlelight flickering, casting uncertain shadows on the yellowed scroll. Master Mo's remnant soul phantom slowly emerged from the first page, and in those eyes that could not看清面容, a hint of unprecedented complexity flickered.

dialogue.content: "Your performance today exceeded my expectations." Master Mo's voice was hoarse and weary, as if it might dissipate into the flickering candlelight at any moment, "Han Lie died without knowing he was merely another piece you captured on your chessboard."

"Sir, who are you really?" Chen Ji raised his gaze to directly stare at the illusory figure, his voicecalm得近乎cold, "From the moment I picked up this scroll, all the 'coincidences' have been too precise. Precise enough to make me怀疑, whether all of this has been within someone's calculation."

"Calculation?" Master Mo let out a low laugh, a laugh carrying inexplicable bitterness, "Do you know, when Chen Tianming left the Tianji Record a thousand years ago, he personally wrote a note—'If my descendants obtain this record through fate, a guardian shall emerge with it.'"

text.content: The candlelight shuddered violently, as if moved by these words. Master Mo's remnant soul slowly drifted before Chen Ji, that blurry face seemingly struggling to gather features, yet always remaining a flowing shadow of light. He reached out, pressing his虚虚的手 on Chen Ji's shoulder—though there was absolutely no touch, Chen Ji felt a warmth spread from his shoulder.

dialogue.content: "I am the 'guardian' you speak of." Master Mo's voice suddenly lowered, "A thousand years ago, Chen Tianming foresaw that your bloodline would face great calamity. When laying his plans, he sealed a strand of my remnant soul within the first page of the Tianji Record. He said, 'If a descendant inherits this record, protect them until they can face heaven's way.'"

choice.prompt: After learning the truth, Chen Ji's heart was filled with mixed emotions. How should he respond to this remnant-soul teacher who had guarded him for a thousand years?

choices.text: Silence and bows, to repay teacher's kindness
choices.description: Chen Ji concealed all his edge, solemnly performing the three kneelings and nine prostrations to Master Mo—this was the first time in his life he showed such respect to anyone.
choices.visible_reward: Deepening the master-disciple bond with Master Mo

text.content: Chen Ji rose, and in the candlelight, those usually cold eyes actually glistened with a thin sheen of water. He reached out to touch Master Mo's remnant soul, but his fingertips pierced through that cluster of light, grasping nothing. At this moment, the one who always had flawless plans actually felt an indescribable powerlessness. "Sir..." His voice was somewhat hoarse, "A thousand years, you guarded a scroll of fragments, waiting for a descendant who might never come. This kindness, Chen Ji cannot repay."

choices.description: Chen Ji suppressed the turmoil in his heart and continued pressing for more truth about the Tianji Record. He needed to know how vast this chess game truly was, and how he should break the局面.
choices.risk_hint: Master Mo may not wish to speak further

dialogue.content: Master Mo sighed, and on that blurry face actually emerged a hint of relieved joy, "Good, good, good. Your question touches the key point. How far-sighted was Chen Tianming's layout back then, would he have left only me alone? The Tianji Record is divided into nine scrolls; the fragment in your hand is merely the remnant page of the first scroll. And I am merely the 'Eighth Chess Player' Chen Tianming set in motion back then."

"The Eighth Chess Player..." Master Mo's voice lowered, as if reciting an ancient incantation, "Do you know, Chess Players are not merely eight? The Eye of Heaven's Way, prophecy seers through the ages, secret legacies of various sects... In this world, too many pieces walk upon the intersecting chessboard. And you and I are merely among them."

text.content: Outside, the night wind suddenly rose, making the window lattices creak. Master Mo's remnant soul grew increasingly dim in this wind, as if it might completely dissipate at any moment. Yet he paid no heed, only slowly raising his hand, as a fragment emanating a faint blue glow emerged from his palm.

dialogue.content: "This is the final key fragment." Master Mo extended that fragment toward Chen Ji, "Gather it, and you can unlock the complete Tianji Record, see all the layouts Chen Tianming left behind. But before that, I want you to remember one thing—"

"The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's deadly backlash becomes." Master Mo's voice suddenly turned sharp, completely different from the gentleness just moments before, "Chen Tianming was such an extraordinarily brilliant figure back then, yet he ended up with his soul scattered and his body destroyed. If you recklessly unlock the complete Tianji Record, be prepared to bear an outcome a hundred times more tragic than his!"

choice.prompt: Facing Master Mo's warning and the final key fragment, Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.text: Accept the fragment, burn the boats
choices.description: Without hesitation, Chen Ji took the fragment. Since fate's chess game had long been set, he would overturn the chessboard and grasp the reins himself!
choices.visible_reward: Gain qualification to unlock the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heaven's Way will gaze upon you more frequently

text.content: Chen Ji took the fragment, and the moment his fingertips touched that pale blue glow, a mighty stream of information instantly flooded into his mind. The Tianji Record's remnant pages began to shake violently, as if sensing some kind of summoning. He saw Chen Tianming's final words left behind—'At the end of heavenly secrets, I battle myself; the one who breaks the局 must first break themselves.'"

choices.text: Temporarily delay action, seek other methods
choices.description: Chen Ji did not immediately accept the fragment. He needed more time to lay his plans, needed more sufficient preparation, rather than recklessly stepping into greater danger.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for in-depth exchange with Master Mo
choices.visible_reward: Retain more Heavenly Fate for future use
choices.risk_hint: Master Mo's remnant soul may not hold on until then

dialogue.content: Looking at Chen Ji's hesitant appearance, Master Mo's dim eyes flashed with understanding, "You are right not to accept." His voice suddenly became extremely weak, "But I have no more time... This remnant soul should have dissipated a hundred years ago. It was Chen Tianming's dying command that made me forcibly endure until now."

text.content: Master Mo's remnant soul began to visibly dissipate, those light particles composing his form scattering like fireflies. Yet he paid no heed, only reaching out his illusory hand, gently stroking Chen Ji's cheek—though nothing was touched, Chen Ji felt a warmth spread from his cheek to the depths of his heart.

dialogue.content: "A thousand years..." Master Mo's voice grew lighter, yet carried an indescribable tenderness, "Watching you grow from a naive child, step by step into someone with flawless plans, I am gratified. If Chen Tianming had knowledge of this in the underworld, he would surely be proud of you."

"I cannot guard any longer." Master Mo suddenly whispered, that cluster of light had faded to near transparency, "But it is alright, what I should do, I have done. The remaining road, you must walk yourself. Remember, the Tianji Record is merely a tool; the one who moves the pieces is always yourself. Do not be frightened by so-called destiny—you are not even afraid of death, so what is there to fear about heaven's way?"

choice.prompt: Facing Master Mo who was about to dissipate, Chen Ji felt unprecedented emotional turmoil.

choices.description: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions within, and solemnly clasped his fists toward that cluster of light about to dissipate. This shout was both farewell and promise.

dialogue.content: "Excellent!" Master Mo let out his final great laugh, the laughter full of satisfaction and liberation, "This word of approval, I waited a thousand years for!" His remnant soul completely scattered into countless specks of light within the laughter, yet one strand of the brightest light shot directly into Chen Ji's body—that was the essence of Master Mo's lifetime of cultivation, his final and heaviest gift.

choices.description: Chen Ji did not speak, only silently placing the key fragment into his怀. He pressed all his emotions into his heart, using actions instead of words—this was his consistent way.

text.content: Looking at Chen Ji's silent appearance, Master Mo's dim eyes showed a hint of a smile, "You, ah, are exactly like Chen Tianming back then, hiding everything in your heart." Before the words finished, his remnant soul transformed into a streak of flowing light, entering that key fragment. Chen Ji only felt a burning heat in his palm, as memory after memory flashed by like a carousel—the past he never knew, the thousand-year master-disciple bond between Chen Tianming and Master Mo.

The light dust gradually dissipated, and the cottage returned to silence. Chen Ji stood alone in place, tightly gripping that fragment carrying a thousand years of memories. He raised his head to gaze out the window, the night sky dark as ink, stars glittering. In a daze, he seemed to see Master Mo's phantom standing beneath the starlight, slowly nodding toward him, then completely merging into that boundless sea of stars.

dialogue.content: "Sir..." Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice hoarse and barely audible, "Rest assured, this road, I will walk to the end." He slowly closed his eyes, feeling that newly-born power within his body—that was the essence of Master Mo's thousand years of cultivation, the final gift he exchanged his life for. The next instant, he abruptly opened his eyes, light erupting from his pupils. Dawn had broken, and a new chess game was about to begin.

text.content: Morning light first appeared, golden sunshine piercing through the thin mist to fall upon the peak of the Tianqing Sect. Chen Ji pushed open the cottage door, and what came to greet him was not only the fresh mountain breeze, but also a密信 that had just slipped beneath the door. He picked up the envelope, only to see four characters written in cinnabar—'Cang Yutian Arrives.' That name made his pupils suddenly contract. Han Lie's wild laughter before death once again echoed in his ears; the pillar of protection for the Great Qin Dynasty had finally come.
